description: What an agent remembers: the stored facts grouped by category, a master switch, an inline edit, pause and resume, a removal that can be undone, the review of what the agent proposed, a search and a status filter, and bulk actions over a selection. The surface renders the snapshot it is given and keeps its own copy of what it reported, so the reader sees an edit, a pause or a removal before the host's round-trip — and a host that re-renders the SAME switch or filter value cannot undo the reader's pick. A failed callback prints a localized error and changes nothing; a slow one puts the row in a busy state and disables its actions instead of letting a second press double the request. Accessibility: every state is a WORD plus an icon (the tone is the third, redundant cue), a group is a real disclosure whose native button keeps the focus, an edit commits on Enter and rolls back on Escape with the focus handed back into the saved row (a focused button would be activated again by the remaining Enter key sequence), every target reaches the 44 px touch size on a coarse pointer, and the surface owns exactly ONE polite live region — the error text is visible next to the rows and is announced through that same region, never through a second one. The status filter is TWO surfaces — the five-segment tray and a real select — and Auto (the default) renders both and lets a container query on the panel's own box swap them, because a tray that has to scroll reads as clipped on a 375 px card. UndoMode=Queue keeps one undo row and one countdown per pending removal (bounded by MaxVisibleUndoRows, past which the OLDEST removal is reported immediately), and EditableFields opts into editing the category or the source beside the text, reported as ONE MemoryEdit naming the fields that moved.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: CollapsedCategories
parameters.description: The categories whose groups are folded, two-way bound with CollapsedCategoriesChanged. Null (the default) starts every group open.

parameters.name: CollapsedCategoriesChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new list of folded categories when a reader folds or unfolds one.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats the confidence, the timestamps and the undo countdown. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time.

parameters.name: EditableFields
parameters.description: Which parts of a memory the inline editor may change. Default Text — exactly the pre-2.11.0 editor. Adding Category or Source renders that field beside the text and reports it through OnEditItem; None removes the Edit action entirely.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the agent may store and use memories at all, two-way bound with EnabledChanged (@bind-Enabled). Default true. While it is off the panel still lists what is already known — without any action — and says that nothing is being stored.

parameters.name: EnabledChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new switch state.

parameters.name: FilterPresentation
parameters.description: How the status filter is presented. Default Auto, which renders the five-segment tray on a wide card and a real select on a narrow one (a container query on the panel's own box, never the viewport). Segmented and Select pin one presentation at every width.

parameters.name: FilterText
parameters.description: The search text, two-way bound with FilterTextChanged (@bind-FilterText). It narrows the rows by the memory's text, its category and its source; the empty string shows everything.

parameters.name: FilterTextChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new search text.

parameters.name: ForgetMode
parameters.description: How a removal is reported. Default UndoWindow, so a memory is only forgotten after the reader can no longer take the removal back.

parameters.name: HeadingLevel
parameters.description: The heading level of the rendered title and the group headings, clamped to 2–6. Default 3.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The memories to show. Null or empty renders the localized empty state, and a null entry inside the list is skipped. The component never mutates the list: it keeps its own copy of what it reported and drops that copy when the host supplies a new instance of the same memory.

parameters.name: OnBulkAction
parameters.description: Fires ONCE with the whole selection when the reader applies a bulk action. A bulk removal reports through this callback only — it does not fire OnForget per row.

parameters.name: OnEdit
parameters.description: Fires with the edited memory (the same id and the new text) when the reader commits an inline edit. The host applies the change; the panel shows its own copy of the new text until the host supplies a new instance.

parameters.name: OnEditItem
parameters.description: Fires with the ONE record describing a committed edit: the id, the values the reader left and the set of fields that actually moved. Preferred over OnEdit as soon as more than the text is editable; when it has a delegate, OnEdit is not invoked by the same commit.

parameters.name: OnForget
parameters.description: Fires when a removal becomes final: at once in Immediate, and when the undo window closes in UndoWindow. A restored removal never fires it.

parameters.name: OnPause
parameters.description: Fires when the reader pauses a memory (it stays stored but is not used).

parameters.name: OnResume
parameters.description: Fires when the reader resumes a paused memory.

parameters.name: OnReview
parameters.description: Fires with the reader's decision about a memory the agent proposed.

parameters.name: Selectable
parameters.description: Whether every row carries a selection checkbox and the bulk bar offers its actions. Default true; a read-mostly host sets it to false.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the heading is rendered. Default true.

parameters.name: StatusFilter
parameters.description: Which states the panel shows, two-way bound with StatusFilterChanged (@bind-StatusFilter). Default All; the filter is a VIEW and never reports anything to the host.

parameters.name: StatusFilterChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new status filter.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: The clock behind the undo countdown. Null (the default) resolves the host's registered TimeProvider and falls back to System, so a test controls the window without sleeping.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The heading above the surface. Null renders the localized default ("Memory").

parameters.name: UndoMode
parameters.description: How many removals may stay undoable at once. Default Single — the pre-2.11.0 rule, so a second Forget reports the first removal at once. Queue keeps one undo row and one countdown per pending removal, up to MaxVisibleUndoRows; past that bound the OLDEST pending removal is reported immediately.

parameters.name: UndoWindow
parameters.description: How long the undo window stays open in UndoWindow. Default five seconds; a zero (or negative) window behaves like Immediate, because a window nobody can reach would silently lose the memory.

examples.title: The panel over the host's own store
examples.code:
<TmMemoryPanel Items="_items"
               @bind-Enabled="_enabled"
               @bind-FilterText="_filter"
               OnEdit="OnEdit"
               OnPause="OnPause"
               OnResume="OnResume"
               OnForget="OnForget"
               OnReview="OnReview"
               OnBulkAction="OnBulk" />

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<MemoryItem> _items = [];
    private bool _enabled = true;
    private string _filter = string.Empty;

    // The host applies every report to its own store and hands the panel a NEW instance.
    private Task OnPause(MemoryItem item)
    {
        _items = [.. _items.Select(memory => memory.Id == item.Id
            ? memory with { Status = MemoryItemStatus.Paused }
            : memory)];
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

examples.title: Forgetting immediately, when the host already confirms elsewhere
A read-only panel that still shows what is known

notes: The panel keeps its own copy of what it reported, so an edit, a pause or a removal is visible before the host round-trip; a NEW instance of the same memory from the host replaces that copy.
A removal is final only when the undo window closes (ForgetMode=UndoWindow): Undo puts the row back and the host is never told, and a zero-length window behaves like Immediate.

One undo window at a time by default: opening a second one reports the previous removal immediately, so nothing is lost silently. UndoMode=Queue instead keeps one row and one countdown per pending removal (each on the injected TimeProvider), bounded by MaxVisibleUndoRows — a seventh removal reports the OLDEST pending one rather than dropping it off the screen.
A bulk action is ONE request through OnBulkAction with a COPY of the selection; a bulk removal does not fire OnForget per row, and a selection the filter hides is pruned.
A callback that throws prints a localized error next to the rows, announces it through the same live region and changes nothing; a slow one disables the row actions with a "Saving…" note.
Enter commits an edit and Escape rolls it back; the focus moves into the saved row and back to the Edit button on a cancel (WCAG 2.4.3).
Every status is a WORD plus an icon, a group is a real disclosure on a native button, and the partial animates nothing.
The editor changes only the fields EditableFields allows: a field the host owns is never rendered and never reported, and an unchanged commit closes without a callback.

A narrow card (a container query on the panel's own box, TmBreakpoints.Sm) swaps the segmented tray for a real select that feeds the SAME two-way StatusFilter; a pinned FilterPresentation keeps its surface at every width.
Every status is a WORD plus an icon, a group is a real disclosure on a native button, and the only movement in the partial is a queued undo row arriving — which prefers-reduced-motion removes.
